text: We often build personal knowledge bases to free our minds, but we rarely calculate the hidden maintenance cost: the "organization tax." Every hour spent meticulously tagging notes, refining back-links, and reformatting layouts is an hour you aren't spent actually creating. If you aren't careful, your digital garden becomes a graveyard of unfinished ideas rather than an engine for deep thought. The system should serve your curiosity, not become a second job requiring constant administrative work.
